title: PosNormalizedMenuValidationResult

valid.description: Indicates whether the input menu is valid for ingestion.

validation_errors.description: If the validation fails, this field contains a description of the problem.

items.description: If the validation fails, this field contains a description of the problem.

description: The results from a normalized menu validation. If successful, the valid property will be true. If the validation fails, the valid property will be false and the validation_errors property will indicate which menu field caused the failure and why.
